x.h: Evangelical Promises; Exhortations to Duty. (b. c. 706.)
p: The scope of these verses is to show that when God is coming towards us in a way of mercy we must go forth to meet him in a way of duty.

x.h: Encouragement to the Sincere; Encouragement to the Gentiles. (b. c. 706.)
p: The prophet is here, in God's name, encouraging those that were hearty in joining themselves to God and yet laboured under great discouragements. 1. Some were discouraged because they were not of the seed of Abraham. …

x.h: A Charge against the Prophets. (b. c. 706.)
p: From words of comfort the prophet here, by a very sudden change of his style, passes to words of reproof and conviction, and goes on in that strain, for the most part, in the three following chapters; and therefore some here begin a new sermon. He had assured the people that in due time God would deliver them out of captivity, which was designed for the comfort of those that should live when God would do this. …
